product_overview: INVOISEN is an AI-powered invoice generator SaaS that helps users create, manage, preview, and export invoices efficiently. The app also supports account access, phone verification, and plan selection during onboarding.
core_goals: Create and manage invoices from a central invoice workspace
Access the application through secure login and account verification
Complete onboarding by selecting an appropriate plan for the user’s region and needs

features.name: Authentication & Phone Verification
features.description: Allows users to log in and complete phone-based WhatsApp verification as part of account access and security.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email credentials -> Submit the login form -> See the authenticated app state
Navigate to /signup -> Enter registration details -> Submit the signup form -> See confirmation of account creation

Navigate to /login -> Enter email credentials -> Submit the login form -> Open phone verification flow -> Request a WhatsApp verification code -> Receive prompt to enter the code -> Enter the 6-digit OTP -> Submit verification code -> See phone verification confirmed
Navigate to /login -> Enter email credentials -> Submit the login form with invalid credentials -> See access denied message

Navigate to /login -> Enter email credentials -> Submit the login form -> Request a WhatsApp verification code -> Enter an incomplete OTP -> Submit verification code -> See validation message for the code

features.name: Invoice Management & Creation
features.description: Provides a workspace for creating, editing, previewing, and exporting invoices using customizable templates.
user_flows: Navigate to /invoices -> View the invoice list
Navigate to /invoices/new -> Start a new invoice -> Enter invoice details -> Add line items -> Choose a template -> Preview the invoice -> Export the invoice as PDF
Navigate to /invoices/new -> Start a new invoice -> Enter invoice details -> Add line items -> Save the invoice -> Return to the invoice list with the new invoice visible
Navigate to /invoices/new -> Start a new invoice -> Leave required invoice fields incomplete -> Attempt to continue -> See validation feedback for missing information

features.name: Plan Selection & Onboarding
features.description: Lets users choose a subscription plan during onboarding, with regional pricing detection and a 14-day Pro trial option.
user_flows: Navigate to /welcome -> View region-adjusted pricing options -> Select a plan -> Confirm the selection -> See the updated account plan
Navigate to /welcome -> View the 14-day Pro trial option -> Select the trial plan -> Confirm the selection -> See trial access enabled
Navigate to /welcome -> View available plans -> Select a plan -> Review the summary before confirming -> Complete onboarding with the chosen plan
